m601-city.observed_description: The edge of a city on a clear day: a large street-map board on the left, a wide empty road running into the distance, a long open-air market with striped awnings on the right, and one tall faceted glass tower.
m601-city.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Every target is plain at phone size and nothing readable is written in the photo. The map carries a few tiny unreadable printed marks and a small legend block; nothing can be read at phone size.
